inputs.name: validateResize
inputs.description: A function that will be called before each resize event. Return `true` to allow the resize event to propagate or `false` to cancel it

inputs.name: enableGhostResize
inputs.description: Set to `true` to enable a temporary resizing effect of the element in between the `resizeStart` and `resizeEnd` events.

inputs.name: resizeSnapGrid
inputs.description:
A snap grid that resize events will be locked to.

e.g. to only allow the element to be resized every 10px set it to `{left: 10, right: 10}`

inputs.name: resizeCursors
inputs.description: The mouse cursors that will be set on the resize edges

inputs.name: ghostElementPositioning
inputs.description: Define the positioning of the ghost element (can be fixed or absolute)

inputs.name: allowNegativeResizes
inputs.description: Allow elements to be resized to negative dimensions

inputs.name: mouseMoveThrottleMS
inputs.description: The mouse move throttle in milliseconds, default: 50 ms

outputs.name: resizeStart
outputs.description: Called when the mouse is pressed and a resize event is about to begin. `$event` is a `ResizeEvent` object.

outputs.name: resizing
outputs.description: Called as the mouse is dragged after a resize event has begun. `$event` is a `ResizeEvent` object.

outputs.name: resizeEnd
outputs.description: Called after the mouse is released after a resize event. `$event` is a `ResizeEvent` object.

inputs.name: resizeEdges
